A FEW THINGS, CLEARED UP

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Less mystery. More peace of mind.

When does Kite launch?

Spring 2026 is the original brief’s fictional launch window, not a current release promise. This concept is not a live product; no access invitations are sent. A real release date is unconfirmed.

Is the waitlist free?

The local demonstration is free. The proposed launch offer gives the first 1,000 three months of Kite Pro. This prototype does not issue access, subscriptions or a real offer.

How does the referral system work?

The proposed rule is 100 places of credit per friend who joins, without a program cap. Your displayed rank stops at #1. “Spots jumped” counts actual places moved; total referral credit can keep growing. The simulation changes only this tab or your explicitly saved local record. Opening or sharing a link never awards credit by itself, and referrals are not tracked between browsers.

What platforms will Kite support?

The concept envisions web, macOS and iOS at launch, with Windows and Android later. There are no apps to download from this prototype and no confirmed platform roadmap.

Will my data be used to train AI?

This page does not connect to your inbox, send data to an AI model or train on email content. Sample replies and messages are local fixtures. Your typed email stays in this tab unless you explicitly choose device storage, which is not encrypted by this page. A real service would need its own reviewed security and privacy terms.

Can I remove my demo signup?

Yes. “Clear my demo signup” removes this tab’s record and its saved copy. Turning off “Remember” removes the saved copy while retaining the current tab’s example. With device storage off, refreshing clears your signup. No marketing subscription is created.
